_meta.purpose: Fixed test set for the micro1 Agentic Workflows Hackathon submission. The exact same 10 sites must be used for the baseline (Phase 1), the full agent pipeline (Phases 2-5), and the evaluation (Phase 6) so the comparison is fair and reproducible.
_meta.source: All 10 businesses were identified via public web search on 2026-08-30. Each is a real, independently or locally operated small business with its own public website (no login walls, no private data). This mirrors BIT's actual outreach target profile: salons, boutiques, clothing stores, and smoke shops in Tyler, TX and Canton, OH.
_meta.do_not_modify: This list must stay fixed once Phase 1 (baseline) is run. If a site goes offline mid-hackathon, log it as a known issue in the changelog rather than silently swapping it out.
_meta.challenging_case: site_09 (OnlyClouds Smoke Shop) is flagged as the deliberately difficult case referenced in the hackathon brief — it is a multi-location chain site rather than a single-location small business, which may make the Critique Agent's issues less clear-cut than a simple outdated single-page site. Confirm this is still the right pick after Phase 2 scraping, and swap the flag to a different site if a better challenging case appears in the data.
